name: PerpRegimeFee
mechanic: reprices the lp fee off hyperliquid perp regimes, with a protocol + operator skim each swap
plain: a dynamic-fee v4 hook. an oracle sets the market regime and beforeSwap overrides the lp fee to match (risk_on 0.10%, neutral 0.30%, risk_off 1.00%). afterSwap takes a mandatory 10 bps aeon fee plus a 10 bps operator fee, on exact-in and exact-out.
rules: beforeSwap sets the lp fee from the oracle regime: risk_on 0.10%, neutral 0.30% default, risk_off 1.00%
only the oracle rotates the regime (updateRegime, onlyOracle)
10 bps aeon fee + 10 bps operator fee, taken to immutable recipients, no custody

fee.note: 10 bps aeon + 10 bps operator, atop the dynamic regime lp fee
